items.title: ProFTPD mod_copy任意文件读写
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可经SITE CPFR/CPTO命令读写任意文件，常导致服务器被控。
items.action_zh: 升级到1.3.5a或更高；禁用mod_copy并限制FTP访问。
items.repro_note: 未授权FTP连接，执行SITE CPFR/CPTO读写文件
items.impact_scope: FTP服务，常暴露公网或内网
items.description: The mod_copy module in ProFTPD 1.3.5 allows remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

items.title: Struts2 DMI命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者在开启DMI时经method:前缀注入OGNL，导致任意代码执行。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.repro_note: 访问带method:前缀的Action注入OGNL；需开DMI
items.impact_scope: Java Web框架，广泛部署于内网
items.description: Apache Struts 2.3.19 to 2.3.20.2, 2.3.21 to 2.3.24.1, and 2.3.25 to 2.3.28, when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled, allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method: prefix, related to chained expressions.

items.title: ONLYOFFICE文档服务器路径遍历RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者经/upload图片参数/..遍历写入文件，在JWT场景可RCE。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.repro_note: 未授权或JWT场景访问/upload，图片参数含/..序列
items.impact_scope: OA协同办公，常暴露内网或公网
items.description: Directory traversal with remote code execution can occur in /upload in ONLYOFFICE Document Server before 5.6.3, when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter.

items.title: Strapi后台查询过滤器信息泄露
items.title_zh: Strapi后台查询过滤器信息泄露
items.summary_zh: 拥有管理面板权限的攻击者利用查询过滤器，可发现敏感用户详情。
items.action_zh: 升级Strapi到4.8.0以上并审计后台权限。
items.repro_note: 登录后台，构造带filter的查询请求读取用户敏感字段
items.description: Strapi through 4.5.5 allows attackers (with access to the admin panel) to discover sensitive user details by exploiting the query filter. If the attacker has admin panel access to an account with permission to access the username and email of API users with a lower privileged role (e.g., Editor or Author), then this can be exploited to discover sensitive information for all API users but not other admin accounts.

items.title: BIND TKEY查询拒绝服务
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者发送特制TKEY查询触发REQUIRE断言失败，导致named退出。
items.repro_note: 向named发送特制TKEY查询触发断言
items.impact_scope: DNS基础设施，关停影响解析
items.description: named in ISC BIND 9.x before 9.9.7-P2 and 9.10.x before 9.10.2-P3 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (REQUIRE assertion failure and daemon exit) via TKEY queries.

items.title: IBM Verify反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者利用反序列化漏洞，在系统上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级到IBM修复版本；限制认证接口暴露。
items.repro_note: 未认证访问反序列化入口，提交恶意序列化数据
items.impact_scope: IAM/身份认证系统，常暴露公网
items.description: IBM Security Verify Access 10.0 through 10.0.9.2 and IBM Verify Identity Access 11.0 through 11.0.3 could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system due to the deserialization of untrusted data.

items.title: IBM Verify反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者利用反序列化漏洞，在系统上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级到IBM修复版本；限制认证接口暴露。
items.repro_note: 未认证访问反序列化入口，提交恶意序列化数据
items.impact_scope: IAM/身份认证系统，常暴露公网
items.description: IBM Security Verify Access 10.0 through 10.0.9.2 and IBM Verify Identity Access 11.0 through 11.0.3 could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system due to the deserialization of untrusted data.

items.title: 任务调度平台缺失认证RCE
items.title_zh: 任务调度平台缺失认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向/jobinfo/addAndStart提交GLUE_SHELL作业，执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级修复；临时禁用/addAndStart或加认证。
items.impact_scope: 内网任务调度，常暴露管理端口
items.description: Dromara Skyeye through commit 003549ae5615bd114ba5bb8ddf6a8e8ead97c321 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in bundled xxl-job-admin JobInfoController endpoints annotated with @PermissionLimit(limit = false). Unauthenticated attackers can POST GLUE_SHELL, GLUE_PYTHON, or GLUE_POWERSHELL jobs with attacker-supplied glueSource to /jobinfo/addAndStart, executing commands on the executor host or stopping and deleting jobs.

items.title: fast-jwt 算法混淆签名绕过
items.title_zh: fast-jwt 算法混淆签名绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者伪造 JWT 签名绕过校验，可越权访问受保护资源。
items.action_zh: 升级到 6.3.0，并显式配置 algorithms 白名单
items.repro_note: createVerifier 未设算法白名单时可用 HS256 伪造签名
items.impact_scope: npm JWT 认证库，影响令牌校验服务
items.description: | |---|:-:| | `createVerifier({ key })` (no `algorithms` allowlist) | ✗ VULNERABLE | | `createVerifier({ key: asyncCallback })` | ✗ VULNERABLE | | `createVerifier({ key, algorithms: ['RS256'] })` | ✓ protected | | `createVerifier({ key, algorithms: ['HS256'] })` | ✗ VULNERABLE (attacker matches) | ### Impact 1.

items.title: PraisonAI文件写入路径遍历RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经AI Coder组件未校验路径写入文件，可能执行任意命令。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级PraisonAI到4.6.78；限制文件写入目录。
items.repro_note: 调用aicoder write_to_file，传入../路径写入恶意文件

items.title: Tenable身份暴露监听器命令注入
items.title_zh: Tenable身份暴露监听器命令注入
items.summary_zh: 低权认证攻击者可经AD事件监听器注入命令，以SYSTEM权限执行。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商升级/打补丁；限制低权账户与PDCe访问。
items.repro_note: 低权账户向AD事件监听器提交恶意事件，触发命令注入
items.description: A command injection vulnerability in the Active Directory Events Listener of Tenable Identity Exposure (SaaS) allows an authenticated, low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary commands as SYSTEM on the PDCe.

items.title: Handlebars模板代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可控模板经compile()绕过AST校验，执行任意JS代码。
items.action_zh: 升级handlebars到4.7.10；勿编译不可信模板。
items.repro_note: 调用compile()传入恶意模板，绕过AST校验执行JS
items.description: This bypasses the AST validation added in 4.7.9 for GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q, GHSA-xhpv-hc6g-r9c6 and GHSA-3mfm-83xf-c92r. - **`compile()`**: arbitrary JavaScript runs in the Node.js process with the application's privileges (remote code execution).

items.title: ppt2png文件路径命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经文件名/路径参数注入shell元字符，以Node权限执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；临时校验过滤文件路径参数。
items.repro_note: 调用ppt2png处理含;等元字符的文件路径
items.impact_scope: Node工具库，依赖调用的服务
items.description: ppt2png through 0.0.6 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute operating system commands by supplying unsanitized input or output path arguments. Attackers can append shell metacharacters such as ';' to file names passed to child_process.exec() in ppt2png.js, running commands with Node.js process privileges.

items.title: dot-access路径参数代码注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向get()传入恶意路径，拼接进Function执行JS命令。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；禁止将用户输入作路径表达式。
items.description: dot-access 0.0.3 through 1.0.0 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute JavaScript by supplying crafted paths to get(). The path is concatenated into a new Function body in index.js, so attackers can reach constructor.constructor to load child_process and run operating system commands in the Node.js process.

items.title: node-convert命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经filepath/convertTo参数注入shell元字符，执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；临时校验过滤转换参数。
items.repro_note: 调用convert传入含单引号/元字符的文件路径
items.impact_scope: Node转换库，依赖调用的服务
items.description: @enmaso/node-convert through 1.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in convert.js that allows attackers to execute shell commands via unsanitized filepath and convertTo arguments. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters or a single quote into the ImageMagick command run by child_process.exec() to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

items.title: image_optimizer命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 启用identify时，攻击者经恶意图像路径注入命令并执行。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；关闭identify或过滤图像路径。
items.repro_note: 启用identify选项，传入含shell元字符的图像路径
items.impact_scope: Ruby图像处理库，依赖调用服务
items.description: The image_optimizer Ruby gem 1.3.0 through 1.9.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ImageOptimizer#identify_format that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying a crafted image path when the identify option is enabled. Attackers controlling the path, such as an uploaded file name, can append shell metacharacters like ';' that are executed via Ruby backticks with the Ruby process privileges.

items.title: TVU设备登录认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者提交空UserName到/tvu/Login，获取管理员会话。
items.action_zh: 升级固件到7.9以上；临时限制管理端访问。
items.impact_scope: 网络视频设备，管理口暴露风险
items.description: TVU Networks Receiver/Transceiver devices running firmware before version 7.9 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web management login endpoint POST /tvu/Login that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to obtain an administrative session by submitting an empty or absent UserName parameter.

items.title: IBM Guardium边缘控制器缺失认证
items.title_zh: IBM Guardium边缘控制器缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者调用edge-controller，执行任意容器并控制边缘集群。
items.action_zh: 升级/应用IBM补丁；限制edge-controller访问。
items.repro_note: 未认证请求edge-controller接口，提交恶意容器镜像
items.impact_scope: 数据安全平台，边缘集群控制
items.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.1 and 12.2.2 are vulnerable to missing authentication in the edge-controller component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary container images and gain control of managed edge clusters.

items.title: Skyeye TTS接口命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者经textToSpeech的format参数注入单引号，执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 升级修复；临时禁用TTS接口或过滤format。
items.repro_note: 未授权访问textToSpeech接口，format参数注入单引号
items.description: Dromara Skyeye through commit 003549ae5615bd114ba5bb8ddf6a8e8ead97c321 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the unauthenticated /post/TtsController/textToSpeech endpoint via the format parameter. Attackers can inject a single quote into format to break out of the PowerShell string and execute commands as the Skyeye service account on Windows.
